title: The Topological Invariants of Algebraic Varieties

definitions.statement: Differential form omega on compact Riemannian/Kähler manifold satisfying Delta omega = (d delta + delta d) omega = 0.
H^k(X, C) = oplus_{p+q=k} H^(p,q)(X) with H^(p,q) conjugate to H^(q,p).
Rational cohomology class in H^(2p)(X, Q) cap H^(p,p)(X).

theorems.label: Hodge Theorem for Compact Kähler Manifolds
theorems.statement: De Rham cohomology decomposes into harmonic forms of type (p,q), and Hodge diamond is symmetric.

theorems.label: Kähler Identities
theorems.statement: [L, Lambda] = (p+q-n) I and [d, Lambda] = i d^c_* relating Lefschetz operator and dual operator.

theorems.label: Lefschetz (1,1) Theorem
theorems.statement: Every integral Hodge class of type (1,1) is the first Chern class of a holomorphic line bundle (algebraic cycle).

conjectures.label: Hodge Conjecture
conjectures.statement: On a projective non-singular complex algebraic variety, every Hodge class in H^(2p)(X, Q) cap H^(p,p)(X) is a rational linear combination of cohomology classes of algebraic subvarieties of codimension p.

conjectures.label: Integral Hodge Conjecture
conjectures.statement: Every integral Hodge class is algebraic.

open_gaps: Atiyah and Hirzebruch (1962) found torsion counterexamples to the integral version, forcing restriction to Q-coefficients.
For codimension p >= 2, no general analytic inversion mechanism exists to construct algebraic cycles from harmonic (p,p)-forms.
computational_handles: Exact Hodge diamond calculation for Fermat hypersurfaces and complete intersections.
Intersection form evaluation on H^2 of K3 surfaces (even unimodular lattice II_3,19).
Period matrix computation for abelian varieties and identification of endomorphism algebras.

citations.ref: Hodge, W.V.D. (1950). The Topological Invariants of Algebraic Varieties, Proc. Int. Congr. Math., Vol. 1, 182-192.
